videos.title: ASML：揭開 High NA EUV 的面貌
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「光學鄰近修正」的延伸背景。辨認曝光系統的光學、載台與整合規模；動畫為導覽，不是組裝施工圖。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Optical proximity correction. Identify the optics, stages and integration scale of an exposure system; the animation is a tour, not assembly drawings. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 找出光罩與晶圓所處的不同位置。
觀察光學系統與精密運動系統如何配合。
把解析度能力與層間對準能力分開記錄。
watchForEn: Locate the distinct positions of mask and wafer.
Observe cooperation between optics and precision motion.
Record resolution capability separately from layer-to-layer alignment.
videos.before: 先問：「疊合設計輪廓與模擬晶圓輪廓」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Overlay target and simulated wafer contours requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「以線端延伸減少縮短」列為查證任務：延伸量須檢查鄰近空間。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Use line-end extension to reduce shortening: Extension must respect neighboring spaces. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

courses.summary: 光學鄰近修正涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用ASML Veldhoven 園區（High-NA 研究代表地）作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: Optical proximity correction involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses ASML Veldhoven campus: High-NA reference location as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.

roles.role: 提供計算微影與曝光機資料，可對照成像誤差模型。
roles.roleEn: Provides computational lithography and scanner data, relevant to imaging-error models.
roles.business: EUV、DUV 微影與圖案化量測系統。
roles.businessEn: EUV and DUV lithography and patterning metrology systems.

roles.role: 光阻材料影響光阻模型，可對照模型校正。
roles.roleEn: Resist materials shape resist models, relevant to model calibration.
roles.business: 矽晶圓、光阻、光罩基板與稀土磁石等材料。
roles.businessEn: Silicon wafers, photoresists, photomask substrates and rare-earth magnets among other materials.

roles.role: 提供 OPC 光罩合成軟體，可對照本課的局部修正與窗口驗證。
roles.roleEn: Provides OPC mask-synthesis software, relevant to local correction and window validation here.
roles.business: EDA、介面 IP、光罩合成（OPC/ILT）、光子設計與多物理模擬（含 Ansys）。
roles.businessEn: EDA, interface IP, mask synthesis (OPC/ILT), photonic design and multiphysics simulation (including Ansys).
